summary: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: \"Flask App Service\", \"Django App Service\", \"FastAPI App Service\", \"deploy Python to App Service\".
whenNotToUse: DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.
verification: Expected: state: Running, linuxFx: PYTHON|3.14 (Azure stores it in pipe form internally — normal), host: <app>.azurewebsites.net.
whenToUse: Use when deploying Python web app code (Flask, Django or FastAPI) to Azure App Service on Linux without writing infrastructure code.
